standard_prerequisites.name: The normalised complex functor N
standard_prerequisites.statement: The functor N from simplicial objects of an abelian category to chain complexes, with the canonical comparison map from N to s.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the functor of the statement (source lines 4218-4220).

standard_prerequisites.name: The canonical splitting of the comparison map
standard_prerequisites.statement: The comparison map N(U) to s(U) is split, so that a morphism is determined by its effect on the normalised subobjects (the author's lemma-splitting-abelian-category, retained as context).

standard_prerequisites.name: The injective-map lemma
standard_prerequisites.statement: The criterion identifying the maps of simplicial abelian objects whose normalised complex map is injective (the author's lemma-injective-map-simplicial-abelian, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives the reflection of injections, surjections and isomorphisms (source lines 4226-4228).

core_obligations: Faithfulness: use the canonical splitting of the comparison map to see that a morphism vanishing on the normalised subobjects is zero (source lines 4224-4225).
Reflection: apply the injective-map lemma to conclude that N reflects injections, and hence surjections and isomorphisms (source lines 4226-4228).

proof_roadmap.step: Deduce faithfulness from the canonical splitting.
Deduce the reflection statements from the injective-map lemma.
